name: Remove Background
description: Cut the subject (person, animal, object) out of an EXISTING workspace image and place it on a new background: transparent, a uniform colour, another image from the workspace, or a NEW SCENE described in a few English words (drawn by the image model without the subject, then the subject is placed on it). The subject is kept pixel for pixel at full resolution and is never redrawn — use THIS, never edit_image, for 'remove the background', 'uniform / white / blue background', 'cut out the person', 'put the person in front of / on a beach'. It also saves a mask of the background (white = background) that edit_image accepts as 'mask' to repaint only behind the subject. The original file is never touched.

image.description: Path of the source image in the workspace, exactly as printed by list_dir or by another tool, folder included (e.g. '_attachments/photo.jpg' for a file the user attached). PNG, JPEG or WebP.

background.description: What goes behind the subject: 'transparent' (default); a colour name or hex code ('blue', 'white', 'light blue', 'solid blue', '#1e3a8a'); the PATH of a workspace image, scaled and centre-cropped to the size of the source; or a short English description of a NEW SCENE ('tropical beach at sunset', 'photo studio, grey backdrop'), which this tool has the image model draw without the subject and then places the subject on. The subject itself is never redrawn.

filename.description: Base name for the saved file, without extension. Optional: derived from the source name.
